list.name: Größte Verluste
list.rawQuery:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
park AS (
        SELECT x.t0, x.t1, x.temp, x.geofence_id, x.address_id,
               EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x.t1 - x.t0)) / 3600.0 AS hours,
               GREATEST(x.p0 - x.p1, 0)::float8 AS loss_km,
               (GREATEST(x.r0 - x.r1, 0) * eff.e)::float8 AS loss_kwh
        FROM (
          SELECT d.end_date AS t0, LEAD(d.start_date) OVER w AS t1,
                 d.end_rated_range_km AS r0,
                 LEAD(d.start_rated_range_km) OVER w AS r1,
                 d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km AS p0,
                 LEAD(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) OVER w AS p1,
                 COALESCE((d.outside_temp_avg
                   + LEAD(d.outside_temp_avg) OVER w) / 2,
                   d.outside_temp_avg) AS temp,
                 d.end_geofence_id AS geofence_id,
                 d.end_address_id AS address_id
          FROM drives d
          WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY d.start_date)) x
        CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE x.t1 IS NOT NULL AND x.r0 IS NOT NULL AND x.r1 IS NOT NULL
          AND x.t1 - x.t0 BETWEEN interval '1 hour' AND interval '30 days'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM charging_processes c
            WHERE c.car_id = $car_id AND c.start_date < x.t1
              AND COALESCE(c.end_date, c.start_date) > x.t0))
SELECT park.t0 AS time, park.t1 AS timeend,
       COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Unbekannt') || ' · ' || ROUND((hours / 24)::numeric, 1) || ' Tage · '
         || ROUND(convert_km((loss_km)::numeric, '$length_unit')) || ' $length_unit verloren' AS text
FROM park LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = park.geofence_id LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = park.address_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(park.t0) AND loss_km > 0
ORDER BY loss_km DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Reichweitenverlust pro Standtag
panels.description: Standverlust pro 24 Stunden Standzeit. Standzeiten ohne Verlust zählen ebenfalls, es ist also ein echter Durchschnitt. Eine Standzeit ist die Zeit zwischen zwei Fahrten ohne Laden dazwischen, von 1 Stunde bis 30 Tagen Dauer.

panels.description: Derselbe Verlust als Anteil der aktuellen Batteriekapazität: um wie viel Prozent der Ladestand pro Standtag sinkt.

eff AS (

                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,

            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
park AS (
        SELECT x.t0, x.t1, x.temp, x.geofence_id, x.address_id,
               EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x.t1 - x.t0)) / 3600.0 AS hours,
               GREATEST(x.p0 - x.p1, 0)::float8 AS loss_km,
               (GREATEST(x.r0 - x.r1, 0) * eff.e)::float8 AS loss_kwh
        FROM (
          SELECT d.end_date AS t0, LEAD(d.start_date) OVER w AS t1,
                 d.end_rated_range_km AS r0,
                 LEAD(d.start_rated_range_km) OVER w AS r1,
                 d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km AS p0,
                 LEAD(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) OVER w AS p1,
                 COALESCE((d.outside_temp_avg
                   + LEAD(d.outside_temp_avg) OVER w) / 2,
                   d.outside_temp_avg) AS temp,
                 d.end_geofence_id AS geofence_id,
                 d.end_address_id AS address_id
          FROM drives d
          WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY d.start_date)) x
        CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE x.t1 IS NOT NULL AND x.r0 IS NOT NULL AND x.r1 IS NOT NULL
          AND x.t1 - x.t0 BETWEEN interval '1 hour' AND interval '30 days'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM charging_processes c
            WHERE c.car_id = $car_id AND c.start_date < x.t1
              AND COALESCE(c.end_date, c.start_date) > x.t0)),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true

CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(loss_kwh) * 24 / NULLIF(SUM(hours), 0) * 100 / NULLIF((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= p.t1 ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z), 0) AS pct FROM park WHERE t0 >= p.t0 AND t0 < p.t1) m ORDER BY p.n

panels.title: Was diese Energie gekostet hat
panels.description: Im Stand verlorene Energie x der Durchschnittspreis pro kWh, den du über alle Ladevorgänge mit Preis bezahlt hast.

WITH periods AS (
        SELECT n, t0, t1 FROM (VALUES
          (1, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - (($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')), ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
          (2, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))) v(n, t0, t1)),
eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id

        SELECT x.t0, x.t1, x.temp, x.geofence_id, x.address_id,
               EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x.t1 - x.t0)) / 3600.0 AS hours,
               GREATEST(x.p0 - x.p1, 0)::float8 AS loss_km,
               (GREATEST(x.r0 - x.r1, 0) * eff.e)::float8 AS loss_kwh
        FROM (
          SELECT d.end_date AS t0, LEAD(d.start_date) OVER w AS t1,
                 d.end_rated_range_km AS r0,
                 LEAD(d.start_rated_range_km) OVER w AS r1,
                 d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km AS p0,
                 LEAD(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) OVER w AS p1,
                 COALESCE((d.outside_temp_avg
                   + LEAD(d.outside_temp_avg) OVER w) / 2,
                   d.outside_temp_avg) AS temp,
                 d.end_geofence_id AS geofence_id,
                 d.end_address_id AS address_id
          FROM drives d
          WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY d.start_date)) x
        CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE x.t1 IS NOT NULL AND x.r0 IS NOT NULL AND x.r1 IS NOT NULL
          AND x.t1 - x.t0 BETWEEN interval '1 hour' AND interval '30 days'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM charging_processes c
            WHERE c.car_id = $car_id AND c.start_date < x.t1
              AND COALESCE(c.end_date, c.start_date) > x.t0)),
chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Unbekannt') AS place,

panels.description: Fläche: Reichweitenverlust an jedem Kalendertag. Eine Standzeit über mehrere Tage wird zeitanteilig auf diese verteilt. Linie: Durchschnitt der letzten 7 Kalendertage.            LEAST(((park.t1) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'), d.day + interval '1 day')

  FROM park JOIN days d ON d.day < ((park.t1) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')
    AND d.day + interval '1 day' > ((park.t0) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone')),
daily AS (SELECT days.day, COALESCE(SUM(parts.loss), 0) AS loss
          FROM days LEFT JOIN parts USING (day) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT ((day) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone') AS time, convert_km((loss)::numeric, '$length_unit') AS "loss__$length_unit",
       convert_km((AVG(loss) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))::numeric, '$length_unit')
         AS "avg7__$length_unit"
FROM daily ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Schlafanteil der Standzeit
panels.description: Anteil der Standzeit, in dem das Auto im gewählten Zeitraum geschlafen hat oder offline war. Ein waches Auto (Wächter-Modus, Innenraum-Überhitzungsschutz, häufige App- oder API-Abfragen) lässt seine Computer laufen und verliert deutlich mehr Reichweite. Die Linie in der Anzeige zeigt den laufenden Wert.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
park AS (
        SELECT x.t0, x.t1, x.temp, x.geofence_id, x.address_id,
               EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x.t1 - x.t0)) / 3600.0 AS hours,
               GREATEST(x.p0 - x.p1, 0)::float8 AS loss_km,
               (GREATEST(x.r0 - x.r1, 0) * eff.e)::float8 AS loss_kwh
        FROM (
          SELECT d.end_date AS t0, LEAD(d.start_date) OVER w AS t1,
                 d.end_rated_range_km AS r0,
                 LEAD(d.start_rated_range_km) OVER w AS r1,
                 d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km AS p0,
                 LEAD(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) OVER w AS p1,
                 COALESCE((d.outside_temp_avg
                   + LEAD(d.outside_temp_avg) OVER w) / 2,
                   d.outside_temp_avg) AS temp,
                 d.end_geofence_id AS geofence_id,
                 d.end_address_id AS address_id
          FROM drives d
          WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY d.start_date)) x
        CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE x.t1 IS NOT NULL AND x.r0 IS NOT NULL AND x.r1 IS NOT NULL
          AND x.t1 - x.t0 BETWEEN interval '1 hour' AND interval '30 days'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM charging_processes c
            WHERE c.car_id = $car_id AND c.start_date < x.t1
              AND COALESCE(c.end_date, c.start_date) > x.t0)),
ps AS (
  SELECT park.t0, park.hours, park.loss_km,
         COALESCE(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
           LEAST(COALESCE(s.end_date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')), park.t1)
           - GREATEST(s.start_date, park.t0))) / 3600.0), 0) AS asleep
  FROM park LEFT JOIN states s ON s.car_id = $car_id
    AND s.state IN ('asleep', 'offline') AND s.start_date < park.t1
    AND COALESCE(s.end_date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) > park.t0
  WHERE $__timeFilter(park.t0)
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3)
 SELECT t0 AS time, SUM(asleep) OVER w * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(hours) OVER w, 0) AS asleep FROM ps WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY t0) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Verlust nach Außentemperatur
panels.description: Reichweitenverlust pro Standtag nach Außentemperatur (Durchschnitt der Fahrten vor und nach der Standzeit). Bei sehr kaltem und sehr heißem Wetter konditioniert das Auto seine Batterie.

                   + LEAD(d.outside_temp_avg) OVER w) / 2,
                   d.outside_temp_avg) AS temp,
                 d.end_geofence_id AS geofence_id,
                 d.end_address_id AS address_id
          FROM drives d
          WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY d.start_date)) x
        CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE x.t1 IS NOT NULL AND x.r0 IS NOT NULL AND x.r1 IS NOT NULL
          AND x.t1 - x.t0 BETWEEN interval '1 hour' AND interval '30 days'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM charging_processes c
            WHERE c.car_id = $car_id AND c.start_date < x.t1
              AND COALESCE(c.end_date, c.start_date) > x.t0)),
tband AS (
        SELECT b, lo, hi,
               CASE WHEN lo IS NULL THEN '< ' || ROUND(convert_celsius((hi)::numeric, '$temp_unit'))
                    WHEN hi IS NULL THEN '> ' || ROUND(convert_celsius((lo)::numeric, '$temp_unit'))
                    ELSE ROUND(convert_celsius((lo)::numeric, '$temp_unit')) || ' – ' || ROUND(convert_celsius((hi)::numeric, '$temp_unit'))
